info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Merwinit Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Merwinit Pendant Detail Submission API facilitates the efficient creation of detailed product information for the Merwinit Pendant. This endpoint allows businesses to add specifications, features, and other relevant details to their product catalog, ensuring comprehensive listings. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory systems that aim to maintain up-to-date catalogs. By utilizing this API, businesses can quickly enrich their product offerings and enhance customer engagement through detailed descriptions.

post.summary: Create or update details for a Merwinit pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new or update existing details for a Merwinit pendant. Ensure that the request body includes all required fields to successfully execute the operation.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the details required to create or update a Merwinit pendant. Ensure that all necessary fields are populated as specified in the schema.

merwinit_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the Merwinit pendant.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the operation is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Merwinit pendant.
